next_action: Register the prefecture's projects in the project stage after fixing the registration unit as the 10 policy fields of the Iwate Prefectural Plan (2019-2028) and confirming the published form of the policy evaluation reports; register the governor's promises in the promise stage from the 2023 election bulletin, which survives only as a copy on an election-information CDN and whose digest could not be collated against an official original; add the assembly layer in the assembly stage, where the FY2025 general-account settlement bill (認定第1号) stands continued in committee and remains pending; keep supplementary budgets, execution and settlement as separate states.
quality_boundary: The prefecture's top-level plan is the Iwate Prefectural Plan (いわて県民計画, 2019-2028). This review fixes that identity, the two-layer structure (the ten-year Long-Term Vision with 10 policy fields, each carrying Iwate happiness-related indicators, plus the Action Plans made of four plans run in three periods), and the progress governance based on the prefecture's policy evaluation of the happiness-related and implementation indicators, deliberated by the Iwate Prefecture Comprehensive Plan Council. Iwate Prefecture had no reviewed package in this repository before this stage, so this review rests on the prefecture's and the MIC's own published documents alone. The registration unit for the project stage is fixed as the policy field (政策分野), the unit at which the prefecture itself evaluates progress.

records.statement: 計画は長期ビジョンとアクションプランで構成される。長期ビジョンは、主観的幸福感に関する12の領域をもとにした8つの政策分野（「健康・余暇」から「自然環境」まで）に、これらを下支えする「社会基盤」「参画」を加えた10の政策分野を設定し、各政策分野に幸福に関連する客観的指標（いわて幸福関連指標）を定める。

records.statement: 進行管理は、県の政策評価により政策分野ごとに「いわて幸福関連指標」と「具体的推進方策指標」の達成状況を測定し、政策評価レポートとして公表する形で行われる。各期のアクションプランの評価結果は次期アクションプランの策定に反映され、策定は岩手県総合計画審議会で審議される。
